hack.root_cause: Vault permission hijack via malicious token self-listing; `as-contract` context abuse
hack.description: AlexLab lost $16M when an attacker deployed a fake token, used the protocol's own permissionless listing feature to gain vault-level access, then drained every asset in one transaction by exploiting Stacks' `as-contract` context shift.
